ns2:course.label: Geotectonics
ns2:course.description: Discussion of plate tectonics theory, and nature and distribution of regional-scale earth structures, such as mountain belts; includes study of geological and geophysical evidence that led to modern interpretations of evolution of earth's lithosphere. Field trip and field trip fee required. Prerequisite: GEOL 411 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: GEOL 411 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Field trip fee ranging from $100 - $200 is required.
